description: Find covered companies and their tickers, latest quarter and next expected report date, sorted by name. Filter by query (name, ticker, sector, country or exchange words), sector or country. Pages of 50 by default (up to 200); total and next_offset tell you whether there are more. Unknown sectors or countries return an error that lists the valid ones.

country.description: Home country, such as United States, Singapore or United Kingdom

offset.description: Where to start, default 0; pass next_offset from the previous page

query.description: Words in the name, ticker, sector, country or exchange, such as 'bank singapore' or 'Barclays'

sector.description: Sector, such as Banking, Insurance, Semiconductors or Software; loose matches work ('Banks')

name: list_companies
title: List companies
